business_problem: Meitu needed to scale AIGC image and video products for both consumer and productivity use cases while controlling GPU cost, accelerating model iteration, and keeping global data movement and user experience reliable.
solution_summary: Meitu used Huawei Cloud to turn AI image and video products from isolated features into a scalable AIGC production platform. The company first moved its core business onto Huawei Cloud's cloud-native distributed infrastructure, then used global one-network connectivity, Cloud Connect, and migration services to build a worldwide compute-and-storage network across cloud and IDC sites. As AIGC workloads expanded, the bottleneck shifted from CPU to GPU, so Meitu adopted Ascend Cloud Service plus ModelArts, CCE, and related tooling to support training, deployment, and inference for more than 19 models across 6+ business modules. ModelArts provides the end-to-end AI workflow from data processing through model deployment, while the global network layer moves large files and training data between sites with lower latency. These capabilities support consumer image apps as well as productivity products such as AI Product Images inside Meitu Design Studio.
